Subject: April 1st Gas Supply Changeover

Sarah,

On Saturday, April 1st, Bayrock Energy will switch the natural gas supply from Tasman Ridge Resources to Southern Gas at Bayrock’s Portside facility.

To facilitate the changeover, we require a technical representative(s) from Tasman Ridge Resources to attend the Portside facility and oversee the operations, ensuring TRR’s interests and equipment are safeguarded.

Please arrange for a TRR technical representative(s) to report at 12:00 noon on April 1st to the Main Security Office at Bayrock’s Portside plant and ask for Bayrock Energy’s Michael Peters, who is coordinating the changeover.

Should you have any questions, please contact me (using the details below) or Michael Peters at (07) 3456 7890, ext 4512.

Thanks and best regards,

Richard
